svg.aria-label: SyncScribe: the browser runs a Tiptap editor on a Yjs document with live cursors, version history and Markdown export. The Next.js server signs people in with GitHub through Auth.js, runs one access check for every action, and mints a two-minute token for a user, document and role. A self-hosted Hocuspocus sync server verifies that token, re-checks the role in Postgres, drops writes from viewers, and closes a socket as soon as access is revoked through Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY. Edits and cursors travel between browser and sync server over a WebSocket in real time.
